# MooJot (มูจด)

> MooJot is a free, open-source Android expense tracker for Thailand. It reads the payment slips that 20 Thai banking and wallet apps save to the phone, then logs and categorizes every expense on the device. There is no account, no ads and no paid plan, and the ledger never leaves the phone. It is an independent alternative to MeowJot (เหมียวจด) and is not affiliated with MeowJot, KASIKORN X or any bank.

Key facts:

- Platform: Android 7.0 or newer, 64-bit. Not on iPhone yet. Installed from an APK at https://moojot.trajectonomics.com/download; a Google Play listing is in progress.
- Price: free. Every feature, no subscription, no ads. Open source under the MIT license.
- Slip reading: K PLUS, SCB EASY, Krungthai NEXT, MAKE, TrueMoney, Dime! and others (20 apps). It reads the slip QR code and the Thai text with on-device OCR, and can scan this month, 3 months or a year back.
- Categories: 247 built-in Thai and English merchant rules; it remembers your fixes. Unlimited custom categories and tags.
- Also: detects transfers between your own accounts, summaries by category or tag, a 6-month comparison, daily budgets, credit card PDF e-statement import (KBank, SCB, KTC, Krungsri, BBL, ttb, UOB, AEON), CSV and JSON export, Thai and English, two themes.
- Privacy: no sign-up and no MooJot server. Google's ML Kit, used for English text on slips, sends Google its own usage metrics but not the photo or its text. Anonymous app usage stats are off unless the user turns them on.
- Publisher: Trajectonomics. Contact: privacy@trajectonomics.com
